iqReview.recoveredFormat: Bundled RPCs co-locate request, parser and mixin functions. Follow local return values, preserve lexical scopes, compose destination mixins, preserve union arms and resolve local enum exports.

removedBuilders.basis: The request and its RPC are absent from the complete new static module index. The old request built fb:thrift_iq / linked_accounts with smax_id 42. WAWebLinkedAccountsGQL remains in the new snapshot; this review does not assert that the server-side IQ was removed.

The old commerce_settings/cart enabled IQ and commerceSettingsResponse parser are absent from the new module. updateCartEnabled retains the GraphQL implementation and no longer falls back to the IQ. The three business_profile IQ builders remain.
The complete old module with privacy/category name=readreceipts value=all|none is absent from the new static module index.

iqReview.arithmetic: 142 old stanzas - 3 removed static builders + 2 new builders = 141. The same changes give 139 - 3 + 2 = 138 typed responses, with all 3 previously degraded responses retained. Server targets: 105 - 3 + 1 = 103. The new newsletter request is runtime-addressed via args.iqTo, so unknown targets become 5 + 1 = 6.

argumentGaps.attributes: 49 - commerce_settings/cart.enabled - privacy/category.value + USync user.common_gid = 48. The added common_gid comes from t.getCommonGid() in a positional mapper, not an addressable builder options object. Newly recovered INT(2)/INT(3) raw-version literals are fixed wire values, not argument gaps.
argumentGaps.children: 10 + USync conditional tctoken = 11. It is supplied by t.getTcToken() in the same positional mapper. Content gaps remain 23 and runtime-target gaps remain 2.

wasmReview.basis: ls_voprf_utils_v2 and LSVoprfWasm, which declared crypto_utils_v2.wasm and bx 30933, are absent from the new complete module index. WAWebTheiaVoprfJsEd25519 remains. The VoIP payload path changes its content hash but remains catalogued; wasm-evidenced bx handles increase from 30 to 36.

incomingReview.basis: The old WAWebHandleMsgParser payment helper read pay and transaction children, participant via attrJidWithType and t via attrInt. That helper and all pay/transaction literals and attrInt(t) calls are absent from the new module. The main participant attrDeviceJid and attrTime(t) remain. Consequently duplicate keys change from participant,t,verified_name with multiplicity 5 to t,verified_name with multiplicity 3. No retained read was dropped.

notificationReview.basis: Notification array positions move because new types sort before existing entries; the flattened-key counts for devices, newsletter and group-source helpers are unchanged. Shadowed group helpers are resolved lexically, restoring linked_group_promote/demote jid and all 184 action shape elements.

mexReview.basis: Presence extraction code is unchanged. Every previously judged retained key keeps a judgement; no retained always/conditional key becomes undetermined. New snapshot declarations introduce 54 previously unrepresented undetermined keys; three existing keys now have a verdict from their changed source call sites. 106 + 54 - 3 = 157. Four added wholly-undetermined operations account for 10 -> 14. These remain explicit unknowns, not invented conditional or always claims.

wamReview.basis: WAM extraction code is unchanged. The complete old/new quality-gaps reports independently verified the input sets and every module parse. Twenty obsolete versioned Windows RawWamEvent modules depart and seven new versions arrive, accounting for 29 - 20 + 7 = 16 uncatalogued sites. Unread arguments: 79 - 20 old versioned modules - 1 renamed contact-search logger + 7 new versions + 1 replacement contact-search logger + 2 added call-user-journey sites + 6 added thread-logging sites = 74. All retained site identities keep the same reason and multiplicity.
